**Tectonic Plate Movement:**

Recent scientific reviews highlight the complexity of plate interactions at triple junctions and the fact that oceanic plates are not as rigid as previously thought and can fracture due to internal forces, potentially linking to seismic activity [utoronto](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFd-4YeyEnfakNvhPr9mqX2A1cdYPmDeOXuzorX43z9eXbTisfsKFVCYReVjcg88iifRrXw8VLROlXTma8XEAJjHRF6RTLfrnBpNLwq2LF9P0fkS_56XoOfguJyJhuhZ0gasEWLpymVE6Xutg9wZngio3NZK3aQ0XFrzpLS8A0cxqF4eZh0YQM_aOn55meXVR3wnOm9p_mPG42G9TWjyH7G97EGkpyy47juTr2Y2B-3B0G8EAxciwsvdxuh2WzLCh3Jyjit4Isr) [utoronto](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQExcirErQPKn2pifdiPQojyTaE7FWUOHjwtGnZSh3I3hvX7-KYMNBFUfV8k4rtLOfxyKIMz1fRZdlM7sZdqxrV6VfOd4y-4P5-ek4GsMb5-T7FLtxo2n3G5eUhJW6t4RzzG8dQwI7VaktXXEsZ2DkChugY9dhUYWQ8lvo12bI2P0LF7RFVA5BnhIl2FHgSi5qIPG86O3I0_LLJSV5ADRNTfZIle5Oq7BHc0tf1gku2fwKiwZa_QO-4uCDwLTB429U_vgII=) [ucdavis](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHOGSz8TkbAc0R9pyAq-SiV3pmhxAf6kLUBJvgtIfjFYjFDC_pT28wx4zZYvZDxXt3iU2nVs9wTyRMEPbz2UmICOWmB23VPAQNM1z0XYkoTkvmlSkDe2l7cPwSkb7AHClY8XijCFQegCJ4mVbuHvpwQ81oDv8k5XbHXnQBl9SOxG2LOnhlk7croiPBUQKcITa_uilDTkd2b) [discovermagazine](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGOvG8WiEnUl5Vh4EOnqDzvWal_cVFNn_GnzX1HS98uO5bfCAMD_IvmciAd8fpestckFQ8qgrvHuwyPjbMioqU_qUeb5x4Ri7p1JiMfgbDuavb3zeHeICDjpwnWMPdtSpFbvUfqFZq2NuE9VzExlqmRF4jo_sO260IrMT_YEGOZUGMD9KC8n51amUDpzVKPedR1-4WVDBapbOVSb3yvqjM9K9M7v7t5KXbXGTzqUj6RzA0=). **Volcanic Activity:**
Volcanic activity is another significant cause of earthquakes. The movement of magma beneath a volcano can fracture rock and generate tremors. This is common in the Pacific Ring of Fire [medium](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGT3YOIyVqdgnSYuCnjGfuCJU_d2gDTH-kgGZE_Vmt22JMw-ENkyzBr0ZLZnyqNBoOvK9gVJZuKUQ0LxAAdfgHy_nYcXdsu1JEFgDBY451Up9NjjTJ3X-df9ClFYQGxtDR_mUSL-REkq-70vDiDA25KnBtgcWuGGzQM4BOcKkbhEB2IvxzoBNTKW9b52E-R9OLHfa7826WgyiHJ8DzpW47yQA==) [geologyscience](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEeWhQwU7nL8YvYm-p6cnmi8FA60THgZ5zwb3lX4Dd4NSTIjVBdmBVupmt7NIoylOanuI83-AYRe2RCDnjawcWnEiB24N4zsi0IRwB4qGXHaY3YjGil4MCJPOa96DR2924ds79xkit9_nSOr9xPO8qrvH-pto10-qw8_hbYdHeVexuw7KDNN_BIGgzwsaeH0AbHAoGgt9QO2dfaHAMruz_2z1QV6TJgV4xmybw-99ueig==). Increased volcanic activity, such as in Iceland and Indonesia in 2025, has led to more frequent earthquake swarms [medium](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGT3YOIyVqdgnSYuCnjGfuCJU_d2gDTH-kgGZE_Vmt22JMw-ENkyzBr0ZLZnyqNBoOvK9gVJZuKUQ0LxAAdfgHy_nYcXdsu1JEFgDBY451Up9NjjTJ3X-df9ClFYQGxtDR_mUSL-REkq-70vDiDA25KnBtgcWuGGzQM4BOcKkbhEB2IvxzoBNTKW9b52E-R9OLHfa7826WgyiHJ8DzpW47yQA==). Volcanic earthquakes are primarily driven by the movement of magma, volcanic fluids, and gases beneath the Earth's surface, which creates stress changes leading to rock fracturing [usgs](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFS1lmzzT8qRQXiXZorV7bZ7mApiMit3ZVPUH-OoK-UmgqLLwhyL-99rx74Gu_EHzC0SRZoANW4RbtyW28gyq3KlzBBcTI02r1t5xt-gffqOmXfrL35__6pFourw8AnWzeOjJxhiW__WRxMFg1ag6LnGpl0EFgAaaeI2-WpF_85LxYL7xCEcbY9mwKwyx0GydY3C_ytYNnpBCYxvpRt) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGiXihgLVKu93j245L-C03_lWhcRPZKVlfvNhdBj_ODVYMDv5S0Ogb_RXnc-jNUX-EanJLzOIUywH0CdbuKC8CQWx1wrRtJrm5-MOHtEwKvI9-RqUrno_mvBMIF4eqU2ZmhKJLTuPj-KYzqR8Hr5D4arlUb) [gfz](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGaCWO7Ls2AgTXQhRkSed5xfaRiD2FVdLZcsaFCK6djReK0cJ1vMClvinWZrgXjzhiH0tgh03xWRdupYZ9-EywGuqA8l-irulq3ecsjFC0T1Y5RUwgAq6Mz9TBiX668S4HivFGuK0r7VEuNSkazyXoLyUz01EYFJtceMXH2SM-4FTgOL-Gcjx4Cs26yG7GhfFLUqyE7kFQGQiOB7iWENPWIj3O9). **Human-Induced Earthquakes (Induced Seismicity):**
Human activities are increasingly contributing to seismic events. Industrial processes like hydraulic fracturing (fracking), wastewater injection, geothermal energy production, and carbon storage projects can lubricate fault lines or alter pore pressure, leading to earthquakes [medium](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGT3YOIyVqdgnSYuCnjGfuCJU_d2gDTH-kgGZE_Vmt22JMw-ENkyzBr0ZLZnyqNBoOvK9gVJZuKUQ0LxAAdfgHy_nYcXdsu1JEFgDBY451Up9NjjTJ3X-df9ClFYQGxtDR_mUSL-REkq-70vDiDA25KnBtgcWuGGzQM4BOcKkbhEB2IvxzoBNTKW9b52E-R9OLHfa7826WgyiHJ8DzpW47yQA==) [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGD7XBiaPDzqWhV1LkJHULVHH6mdF_laL0pQR4Wp7d2PuEWhnJF4jw6Dws-ySjNmdF15-IbNsLG8KSCKOPeHlcQStMDKxvC4B5uggBjIk4oOzBuU1d0brc9JD6kVs-CqnKafrs2eNIQvv9ynfSM5hu2V_VXro5u9T4=) [myscience](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEHYUduYQD7baq6vcuoCGfEbC5euIe9ea_TqLwm3_9oDVqeAbkZiQ5WP_Jl4TBoLsoPcqYI5Ca3hrv1rks1dIcv7tV9ZBYG4n3Iq6AAqZhHDYeQ6L7ONLf3aXXIAZMlh-D_5Tb1zRCrjHvp

For instance, deforestation driven by consumption in 24 developed countries was responsible for 13.3% of global range loss for forest-dependent vertebrates [princeton](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoIbNqg9jyBVDEPCi3Siu0k_8Wxh6sDLt0dWZF9G1Vy2jYKmaiCWZ2Ge8_avMdvM3aCT8G8tNt_FpnAzV2Yosr3mEW5o98ENok7t_UUtljglwmyWO3b7Fs-Svo84FEMYgVHiL-oh7Hsi_9OA==0).

**Soil and Water Resources:**
Deforestation significantly disrupts hydrological cycles, leading to reduced rainfall, altered river flow, and diminished water availability [earth](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuEMDSanJ4iUSP4gZm2dOMaHOcdx9npRKOI91gE8V_fi31WKheAQvLzjkrQzAtKe2xkiOllwWp75gMH0qI-q_Z5KlYjc4k_DpNG4Dh_2D3jXYP-Q7i_OcInRhecJ0uQQzf5zaDUJiyPhGv6JLspNFbLWLurknDYgx978g=) [earthday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoIbNqg9jyBVDEPCi3Siu0k_8Wxh6sDLt0dWZF9G1Vy2jYKmaiCWZ2Ge8_avMdvM3aCT8G8tNt_FpnAzV2Yosr3mEW5o98ENok7t_UUtljglwmyWO3b7Fs-Svo84FEMYgVHiL-oh7Hsi_9OA==1) [consultqe](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoIbNqg9jyBVDEPCi3Siu0k_8Wxh6sDLt0dWZF9G1Vy2jYKmaiCWZ2Ge8_avMdvM3aCT8G8tNt_FpnAzV2Yosr3mEW5o98ENok7t_UUtljglwmyWO3b7Fs-Svo84FEMYgVHiL-oh7Hsi_9OA==2). Forests are essential for maintaining soil health by preventing erosion and retaining moisture. When cleared, soil is exposed, leading to increased erosion, loss of topsoil, and poorer water quality [earth](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuEMDSanJ4iUSP4gZm2dOMaHOcdx9npRKOI91gE8V_fi31WKheAQvLzjkrQzAtKe2xkiOllwWp75gMH0qI-q_Z5KlYjc4k_DpNG4Dh_2D3jXYP-Q7i_OcInRhecJ0uQQzf5zaDUJiyPhGv6JLspNFbLWLurknDYgx978g=) [earthday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoIbNqg9jyBVDEPCi3Siu0k_8Wxh6sDLt0dWZF9G1Vy2jYKmaiCWZ2Ge8_avMdvM3aCT8G8tNt_FpnAzV2Yosr3mEW5o98ENok7t_UUtljglwmyWO3b7Fs-Svo84FEMYgVHiL-oh7Hsi_9OA==1) [researchgate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoIbNqg9jyBVDEPCi3Siu0k_8Wxh6sDLt0dWZF9G1Vy2jYKmaiCWZ2Ge8_avMdvM3aCT8G8tNt_FpnAzV2Yosr3mEW5o98ENok7t_UUtljglwmyWO3b7Fs-Svo84FEMYgVHiL-oh7Hsi_9OA==3). In the Amazon, research suggests that at least 80% of trees are needed to sustain the hydrological cycle, and substantial forest loss is pushing the region towards a tipping point [earth](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuEMDSanJ4iUSP4gZm2dOMaHOcdx9npRKOI91gE8V_fi31WKheAQvLzjkrQzAtKe2xkiOllwWp75gMH0qI-q_Z5KlYjc4k_DpNG4Dh_2D3jXYP-Q7i_OcInRhecJ0uQQzf5zaDUJiyPhGv6JLspNFbLWLurknDYgx978g=). Deforestation also negatively impacts soil biodiversity and its ability to regulate nutrients, store carbon, and decompose organic matter, with these effects being most severe when forests are converted to croplands [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoIbNqg9jyBVDEPCi3Siu0k_8Wxh6sDLt0dWZF9G1Vy2jYKmaiCWZ2Ge8_avMdvM3aCT8G8tNt_FpnAzV2Yosr3mEW5o98ENok7t_UUtljglwmyWO3b7Fs-Svo84FEMYgVHiL-oh7Hsi_9OA==4).
